entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3980045523465047168: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 32.3697 +/- 0.0241 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 30.89 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -204.891, 41.839 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.547 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..76M/abstract). Mass 0.556 +/- 0.042 solar masses from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..76M/abstract). Temperature 3863 +/- 77 K from Mallorquín et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1801 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,863 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd09e. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,863 K and log g 4.71 (u1 0.458, u2 0.297): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
